answer: The meadow cap is enforced at intake and juniper reveals the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a army of identities in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, since every identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a wharf tag. That is 25 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
